content_blocks.title: ¡Orgullo Railsplitter!
content_blocks.text: Lincoln High School es el hogar de más de 2,300 estudiantes con una rica tradición académica, artística y deportiva en el sur de Des Moines.
Nuestra Misión y Comunidad
En Lincoln nos aseguramos de que cada estudiante tenga acceso a oportunidades académicas de excelencia, apoyo emocional y orientación hacia la universidad y carreras profesionales.

items: Horario escolar general: 8:25 AM a 3:25 PM (Miércoles salida temprana a las 1:55 PM).

Teléfono principal de atención: 515-242-7500.
Enlace bilingüe en español para familias: 515-242-7508.

content_blocks.title: Railsplitter Pride!
content_blocks.text: Lincoln High School is home to over 2,300 students with a rich tradition of academics, arts, and athletics in South Des Moines.
Our Mission & Community
At Lincoln, we ensure every student has access to academic excellence, social-emotional support, and future college and career pathways.

items: Regular school hours: 8:25 AM to 3:25 PM (Wednesday early dismissal at 1:55 PM).
Main campus address: 2600 SW 9th St, Des Moines, IA 50315.
Main office phone: 515-242-7500.

article_translations.title: Guía para familias nuevas
article_translations.summary: Pasos esenciales para estudiantes que ingresan por primera vez o se trasladan a Lincoln.

content_blocks.text: Primeros Pasos al Llegar
Si tu familia es nueva en el distrito o se mudó recientemente, te recomendamos completar estos cuatro pasos:

items: 1. Verifica tu registro en el sistema Infinite Campus.
2. Solicita tu tarjeta de autobús DART en la oficina principal si no tienes transporte escolar asignado.
3. Conoce al consejero académico y al Enlace Bilingüe (BFL) de tu estudiante.
4. Descarga la aplicación escolar DMPS Mobile para recibir notificaciones directas.

article_translations.title: Guide for New Families
article_translations.summary: Essential steps for students enrolling for the first time or transferring to Lincoln.

content_blocks.text: First Steps Upon Arrival
If your family is new to the district or recently moved, we recommend following these four steps:

items: 1. Verify enrollment in the Infinite Campus portal.
2. Request your student DART bus pass at the main office if yellow bus is not assigned.
3. Meet your student's assigned counselor and Bilingual Family Liaison (BFL).
4. Download the DMPS Mobile app for instant district notifications.

content_blocks.text: DMPS Info was built so every Des Moines family can find clear answers about school without language barriers.

School Switcher: Select Lincoln or East High to view school-specific details.

article_translations.title: Lincoln High School ကၠိခိၣ်နားတၢ်ဆၢကတီၢ်
Cierres, retrasos y cambios escolares
article_translations.summary: Qué hacer cuando hay nieve, frío extremo o emergencias climáticas en Des Moines.

content_blocks.text: Durante el invierno, el superintendente evalúa las condiciones de las calles a las 5:00 AM para decidir si las clases se retrasan 2 horas o se cancelan.

items: Retraso de 2 horas: Las clases comienzan a las 10:25 AM y los autobuses pasan 2 horas después de su horario habitual.
Cierre total: No hay clases ni actividades extracurriculares.
Medios de aviso: Mensaje de texto Infinite Campus, canales de TV locales (KCCI, WHO13) y DMPS Info.

article_translations.title: School Closings, Delays & Weather Changes
article_translations.summary: Protocol for snow, severe cold, and emergency weather delays in Des Moines.

content_blocks.text: During winter, DMPS assesses road safety by 5:00 AM to determine if a 2-hour delay or school closing is needed.

items: 2-Hour Delay: Classes begin at 10:25 AM; buses run exactly 2 hours later.
School Closure: All classes, building activities, and evening sports are canceled.
Where to check: Infinite Campus SMS alerts, local news (KCCI, WHO13), and DMPS Info.

content_blocks.text: ဖဲမူခိၣ်တၢ်အိၣ်သးအၢအခါ ကၠိတၢ်ပရၢကဟဲခီဖျိ လီတဲစိတၢ်ဆှၢပရၢ ဒီးတီဝံၣ်တၢ်ပရၢ.

article_translations.title: Cómo registrar a un estudiante
article_translations.summary: Requisitos de inscripción, documentos necesarios (comprobante de domicilio, cartilla de vacunación) y registro en línea.

content_blocks.text: Documentos Requeridos

items: 1. Comprobante de edad del estudiante (acta de nacimiento o pasaporte).
2. Comprobante de domicilio en Des Moines (factura de servicios públicos o contrato de arrendamiento).
3. Registro oficial de vacunas de Iowa.
4. Boletas o expediente escolar de la escuela anterior.

content_blocks.text: El proceso se completa a través del portal de Registro en Línea de DMPS o en el Centro de Bienvenida del Distrito (Welcome Center).

article_translations.title: How to Register a Student
article_translations.summary: Enrollment requirements, required documents (proof of residency, immunization records), and online registration.

content_blocks.text: Required Documents

items: 1. Proof of student age (birth certificate or passport).
2. Proof of Des Moines residency (utility bill or lease agreement).
3. Iowa Certificate of Immunization.
4. Academic transcripts or records from prior school.

content_blocks.text: Complete online enrollment via DMPS Online Registration or visit the DMPS Welcome Center.

article_translations.title: Cómo entrar a Infinite Campus
article_translations.summary: Crea tu cuenta del Portal para Padres, recupera tu contraseña y descarga la app en tu teléfono.

content_blocks.text: Infinite Campus es la plataforma oficial donde las familias consultan calificaciones, tareas pendientes, asistencia diaria y avisos escolares.

items: 1. Ingresa a la página oficial de Infinite Campus Parent Portal de Des Moines.
2. Si es tu primera vez, solicita tu Clave de Activación (Activation Key) a la oficina de Lincoln.
3. Descarga la aplicación 'Campus Parent' en App Store o Google Play Store.

article_translations.title: How to Log into Infinite Campus
article_translations.summary: Create your Parent Portal account, reset passwords, and download the mobile app.

content_blocks.text: Infinite Campus is the official system for tracking student grades, assignments, attendance, and school announcements.

items: 1. Visit the official Des Moines Infinite Campus Parent Portal.
2. If registering for the first time, request an Activation Key from Lincoln's office.
3. Download the 'Campus Parent' mobile app on iOS or Android.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကနုာ်လီၤဆူ Infinite Campus
article_translations.summary: ကျဲလၢကသူဝဲ Campus Parent app ဖဲလီတဲစိအပူၤ.

content_blocks.text: သူ Infinite Campus ဒ်သိးနကကွၢ်နီၣ်ဂံၢ် ဒီးတၢ်ဟဲကၠိကိးနံၤဒဲး.

article_translations.title: Cómo revisar calificaciones y asistencia
article_translations.summary: Entiende la escala de calificaciones, cómo ver notas por periodo y monitorear faltas en vivo.

content_blocks.text: En Infinite Campus puedes ver el reporte de calificaciones de cada materia y revisar si tu hijo asistió a cada periodo de clase.

article_translations.title: How to Check Grades & Attendance
article_translations.summary: Understand grading scales, period-by-period grades, and live attendance monitoring.

content_blocks.text: In Infinite Campus you can view current grades for each class and check real-time attendance for every period.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကကွၢ်နီၣ်ဂံၢ်ဒီးတၢ်ဟဲကၠိ
article_translations.summary: ကွၢ်ကၠိဖိအနီၣ်ဂံၢ်ဒီး ကၠိတၢ်မၤလိတဖၣ်ဖဲ Infinite Campus.

content_blocks.text: နကွၢ်နီၣ်ဂံၢ်ဒီးတၢ်ဟဲကၠိသ့ဖဲ Infinite Campus တၢ်ပရၢအပူၤ.

article_translations.title: Cómo actualizar la información familiar
article_translations.summary: Cambio de número de teléfono, dirección o contactos de emergencia en el sistema.

content_blocks.text: Es vital que la escuela cuente con tu teléfono y dirección actualizados para emergencias y avisos de transporte.

article_translations.title: How to Update Family Contact Information
article_translations.summary: Change phone numbers, home address, or emergency contacts in the district system.

content_blocks.text: It is critical that the school has updated phone numbers and addresses for emergency alerts and bus routing.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကမၤသီထီၣ် ဟံၣ်ဖိဃီဖိအပရၢ

content_blocks.text: မၤသီထီၣ်နလီတဲစိနီၣ်ဂံၢ်ဖဲ Infinite Campus အပူၤဒ်သိးကၠိကဆဲးကျိးနၤသ့အခါ.

article_translations.title: Transporte escolar de DMPS
article_translations.summary: Reglas de elegibilidad para el autobús escolar amarillo y asignación de paradas.

content_blocks.title: Criterio de Distancia
content_blocks.text: Para estudiantes de preparatoria (grados 9-12), DMPS proporciona transporte si viven a más de 3 millas de su escuela asignada.
La información sobre la ruta, número de autobús y hora de recogida se publica en la cuenta de Infinite Campus de cada familia.

article_translations.title: DMPS School Transportation
article_translations.summary: Eligibility rules for yellow school buses and bus stop assignments.

content_blocks.title: Distance Eligibility
content_blocks.text: For high school students (grades 9-12), DMPS provides bus transportation if living more than 3 miles from assigned school.
Bus route numbers, stop locations, and pickup times are published in each family's Infinite Campus account.

article_translations.title: DMPS ကၠိတၢ်လဲၤတၢ်က့
Cómo llegar a Lincoln usando DART
article_translations.summary: Rutas de autobús público DART (Ruta 7 y 8) y cómo los estudiantes viajan gratis con su credencial.

content_blocks.text: Todos los estudiantes de Lincoln High School pueden viajar GRATIS en cualquier autobús de DART presentando su identificación escolar de estudiante (Student ID).

items: Ruta 7 (SW 9th): Conecta directo con el campus principal de Lincoln y el centro de Des Moines (DART Central Station).
Ruta 8 (Fleur Dr): Conecta con el área oeste y el campus RAILS de 9º grado.

article_translations.title: How to Get to Lincoln Using DART Transit
article_translations.summary: DART public transit routes (Route 7 and Route 8) and free student rides with Student ID.

content_blocks.text: All Lincoln High School students ride DART public buses for FREE by showing their current school Student ID.

items: Route 7 (SW 9th): Direct access to Lincoln Main Campus and DART Central Station downtown.
Route 8 (Fleur Dr): Serves the west corridor and the RAILS 9th Grade Academy.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကလဲၤဆူ Lincoln ခီဖျိ DART ဘၢးစ်
article_translations.summary: DART ဘၢးစ်ကျဲတဖၣ် (Route 7 ဒီး Route 8) ဒီးကၠိဖိကဒ်လၢတၢ်လဲၤအခ့အဖျါတအိၣ်.

content_blocks.text: ကၠိဖိကိးဂၤသူဝဲ DART ဘၢးစ်လၢအခ့အဖျါတအိၣ်သ့ ခီဖျိပာ်ဖျါကၠိဖိကဒ်.

article_translations.title: Qué hacer si el autobús se retrasa
article_translations.summary: Contactos del departamento de transporte de DMPS y cómo rastrear el autobús.

content_blocks.text: Si el autobús escolar no ha pasado después de 15 minutos de la hora programada, llama a Despacho de Transporte al 515-242-7887.

article_translations.title: What to Do If the School Bus Is Delayed
article_translations.summary: DMPS Transportation Dispatch contact and how to check bus delays.

content_blocks.text: If your school bus is more than 15 minutes late, contact DMPS Transportation Dispatch at 515-242-7887.

article_translations.title: Cómo consultar el menú de Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Consulta el menú diario de desayunos y almuerzos en la plataforma Nutrislice.

content_blocks.text: El menú escolar se publica mensualmente con información sobre ingredientes, calorías y alérgenos en dmschools.nutrislice.com.

article_translations.title: How to Check Lincoln's Daily Menu
article_translations.summary: View daily breakfast and lunch menus on the Nutrislice dining platform.

content_blocks.text: School menus are published monthly with full nutrition and allergen details at dmschools.nutrislice.com.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကကွၢ် Lincoln ကၠိတၢ်အီၣ်ခီၣ်မံၤ
article_translations.summary: ကွၢ်ကၠိတၢ်အီၣ်တၢ်အီခီၣ်မံၤဖဲ Nutrislice တၢ်ပရၢအပူၤ.

content_blocks.text: ကၠိတၢ်အီၣ်ခီၣ်မံၤအိၣ်ဖဲ dmschools.nutrislice.com အပူၤ.

article_translations.title: Información sobre comidas escolares
article_translations.summary: Desayuno gratis para todos los estudiantes y programa de almuerzo escolar.

content_blocks.text: En Des Moines Public Schools, el desayuno es 100% gratuito para todos los estudiantes cada mañana antes de iniciar clases.

article_translations.title: School Meal Program Information
article_translations.summary: Universal free breakfast for all students and school lunch program guidelines.

content_blocks.text: In Des Moines Public Schools, breakfast is 100% free for all students every morning before the first bell.
ကၠိတၢ်အီၣ်ဂီၤမ့ၢ်တၢ်လၢအခ့အဖျါတအိၣ်လၢ ကၠိဖိကိးဂၤဒဲးဖဲ DMPS အပူၤ.

article_translations.title: Alergias y necesidades alimentarias
article_translations.summary: Cómo solicitar adaptaciones de menú por alergias a nueces, leche, gluten o dietas religiosas.

content_blocks.text: Si tu estudiante tiene una alergia severa o requiere menú especial, entrega el formulario médico en la enfermería escolar.

article_translations.title: Allergies & Dietary Accommodations
article_translations.summary: How to request meal accommodations for nut allergies, dairy, gluten, or religious dietary needs.

content_blocks.text: If your student has food allergies or medical dietary needs, submit the Diet Modification Form to the school nurse.

article_translations.title: တၢ်အီၣ်လၢတဘၣ်သးဒီးတၢ်အီၣ်အဂၤတဖၣ်
Deportes disponibles en Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Deportes de otoño, invierno y primavera: fútbol, básquetbol, fútbol americano, voleibol, atletismo y más.

content_blocks.text: Deportes por Temporada

items: Otoño: Fútbol americano, voleibol, campo traviesa, natación femenil, golf varonil.
Invierno: Básquetbol varonil y femenil, lucha olímpica (wrestling), natación varonil, boliche.
Primavera: Fútbol (soccer) varonil y femenil, atletismo (track & field), tenis, golf femenil.
Verano: Béisbol y sóftbol.

article_translations.title: Sports Available at Lincoln High School
article_translations.summary: Fall, winter, and spring sports: soccer, basketball, football, volleyball, track & field, and more.

content_blocks.text: Sports by Season

items: Fall: Football, Volleyball, Cross Country, Girls Swimming, Boys Golf.
Winter: Boys & Girls Basketball, Wrestling, Boys Swimming, Bowling.
Spring: Boys & Girls Soccer, Track & Field, Tennis, Girls Golf.
Summer: Baseball and Softball.

article_translations.title: တၢ်လုၢ်လၢ်အိၣ်ဝဲဖဲ Lincoln High School

content_blocks.text: Lincoln အိၣ်ဒီးတၢ်လုၢ်လၢ်အဘုၣ်တဖၣ်လၢ ကၠိဖိခဲလၢာ် ကမၤနီၣ်မံၤဒီးပြၢတၢ်.

article_translations.title: Actividades extracurriculares de Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Clubes de robótica, banda de música, coro, teatro, consejo estudiantil y organizaciones culturales.

content_blocks.text: Participar en clubes escolares ayuda a los estudiantes a hacer amigos, desarrollar liderazgo y enriquecer su expediente universitario.

article_translations.title: Lincoln Extracurricular Clubs & Activities
article_translations.summary: Robotics club, marching band, choir, theater, student council, and cultural affinity groups.

content_blocks.text: Extracurricular clubs help students build leadership skills, make lasting friendships, and strengthen college applications.

article_translations.title: Lincoln ကၠိအချၢတၢ်မၤသကိးတဖၣ်
article_translations.summary: တၢ်သးဝါ, သီခါရူ, ကၠိဖိကရူၢ် ဒီးတၢ်မၤသကိးတဖၣ်.

content_blocks.text: ကၠိဖိမၤနုာ်လီၤသးလၢ ကၠိဖိကရူၢ်တဖၣ်အပူၤသ့.

article_translations.title: Cómo registrarse en un deporte o actividad
article_translations.summary: Examen físico deportivo obligatorio, registro en Bound y consentimiento de padres.

content_blocks.text: Todos los atletas deben tener un examen físico vigente firmado por un médico y estar registrados en la plataforma Bound.

article_translations.title: How to Register for Sports or Activities
article_translations.summary: Mandatory sports physical exam, Bound registration, and parent consent forms.

content_blocks.text: All athletes must have an up-to-date sports physical on file and be registered on Bound before the first practice.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကမၤနီၣ်မံၤလၢ တၢ်လုၢ်လၢ်တၢ်မၤအဂီၢ်
article_translations.summary: ကသံၣ်သရၣ်တၢ်အုၣ်သးလၢ တၢ်လုၢ်လၢ်အဂီၢ် ဒီး Bound တၢ်မၤနီၣ်မံၤ.

content_blocks.text: မၤနီၣ်မံၤဖဲ Bound တၢ်ပရၢအပူၤဒီး ဟ့ၣ်လံာ်ကသံၣ်သရၣ်တၢ်အုၣ်သး.

article_translations.title: Cómo consultar juegos, eventos y resultados
article_translations.summary: Boletos digitales, sedes de partidos y tabla de posiciones de Lincoln Railsplitters.

content_blocks.text: Sigue los horarios de partidos, resultados en vivo y compra boletos digitales en gobound.com/ia/ighsau/lincoln.

article_translations.title: How to View Game Schedules, Events & Scores
article_translations.summary: Digital tickets, game locations, and standings for Lincoln Railsplitters.

content_blocks.text: Track game schedules, live scores, and purchase digital admission tickets at gobound.com/ia/ighsau/lincoln.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကကွၢ်တၢ်ပြၢတၢ်ဆၢကတီၢ်ဒီးတၢ်ဒိးန့ၢ်နီၣ်ဂံၢ်
article_translations.summary: ကွၢ်တၢ်ပြၢတၢ်ဆၢကတီၢ်ဖဲ Bound တၢ်ပရၢအပူၤ.

content_blocks.text: ကွၢ်တၢ်ပြၢတၢ်ဆၢကတီၢ်ဖဲ gobound.com တၢ်ပရၢအပူၤသ့.

article_translations.title: Programas disponibles en Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Programas de Colocación Avanzada (AP), Central Campus técnico y Academy de 9.º grado.

content_blocks.text: Lincoln ofrece más de 20 cursos AP con créditos universitarios, programas bilingües y acceso a carreras técnicas en Central Campus.

article_translations.title: Academic Programs Available at Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Advanced Placement (AP) courses, Central Campus career tech, and 9th Grade Academy.

content_blocks.text: Lincoln offers 20+ AP college credit courses, ELL dual-language programs, and vocational training at Central Campus.

article_translations.title: တၢ်ကူၣ်ဘၣ်ကူၣ်သ့တၢ်ရဲၣ်တၢ်ကျဲၤဖဲ Lincoln
article_translations.summary: AP တၢ်မၤလိ, Central Campus ဒီးတၢ်ကတဲာ်ကတီၤလၢကၠိဒိၣ်အဂီၢ်.

content_blocks.text: Lincoln အိၣ်ဒီးတၢ်ကူၣ်ဘၣ်ကူၣ်သ့တၢ်ရဲၣ်တၢ်ကျဲၤအါမံၤလၢ ကၠိဖိအဂီၢ်.

article_translations.title: Voluntariado y Silver Cord
article_translations.summary: Cómo acumular 160 horas de servicio comunitario para graduarse con el prestigioso Cordón de Plata.

content_blocks.text: El programa Silver Cord reconoce a los estudiantes que completan al menos 40 horas de voluntariado por año de preparatoria.

article_translations.title: Volunteering & Silver Cord Honor Program
article_translations.summary: How to complete 160 hours of community service to earn the Silver Cord at graduation.

content_blocks.text: The Silver Cord program honors high school students who perform 40+ hours of community service each school year.

article_translations.title: တၢ်မၤစၢၤပှၤဂီၢ်မုၢ် ဒီး Silver Cord တၢ်ရဲၣ်တၢ်ကျဲၤ
article_translations.summary: တၢ်မၤစၢၤပှၤဂီၢ်မုၢ် အနၣ်ရံၣ် ၁၆၀ ဒီးဒိးန့ၢ် Silver Cord လၢကၠိဖျိးတၢ်မၤအပူၤ.

content_blocks.text: မၤစၢၤပှၤဂီၢ်မုၢ်ဒီး ကၠိဖျိးဒီး Silver Cord တၢ်လၤကပီၤ.

article_translations.title: Universidad y carreras
article_translations.summary: Orientación universitaria, ayuda financiera FAFSA, becas escolares y visitas a universidades.

content_blocks.text: El Centro de Consejería guía a las familias en la solicitud de becas, beca Iowa Last Dollar y talleres de llenado de FAFSA.

article_translations.title: College, Careers & Future Pathways
article_translations.summary: College advising, FAFSA financial aid workshops, scholarships, and campus visits.

content_blocks.text: Counselors guide students and families through college applications, Iowa Last Dollar scholarships, and FAFSA completion.

article_translations.title: ကၠိဒိၣ်, တၢ်မၤဒီးခါဆူညါတၢ်ကျဲ
article_translations.summary: FAFSA စ့တၢ်မၤစၢၤ ဒီးတၢ်ကတဲာ်ကတီၤလၢကၠိဒိၣ်အဂီၢ်.

content_blocks.text: သရၣ်ဟ့ၣ်ကူၣ်တၢ် ကမၤစၢၤကၠိဖိလၢ FAFSA ဒီးကၠိဒိၣ်တၢ်မၤစၢၤစ့အဂီၢ်.

article_translations.title: Requisitos de graduación
article_translations.summary: Créditos necesarios en inglés, matemáticas, ciencias, estudios sociales y educación física para graduarse.

content_blocks.text: Se requieren 23 créditos académicos totales para obtener el diploma de preparatoria de Des Moines Public Schools.

article_translations.title: High School Graduation Requirements
article_translations.summary: Required credits in English, Math, Science, Social Studies, and Physical Education.

content_blocks.text: Students must complete 23 total academic credits to earn an official Des Moines Public Schools high school diploma.

article_translations.title: Cómo reportar una ausencia
article_translations.summary: Llama a la línea de asistencia al 515-242-7504 antes de las 9:00 AM si tu estudiante no asistirá.

content_blocks.title: Línea de Asistencia
content_blocks.text: Llama al 515-242-7504 o envía un mensaje en Infinite Campus indicando el nombre completo del estudiante, grado y motivo de la falta.
Las faltas justificadas incluyen enfermedad, citas médicas o dentales con comprobante y emergencias familiares.

article_translations.title: How to Report a Student Absence
article_translations.summary: Call the attendance line at 515-242-7504 before 9:00 AM if your student is missing school.

content_blocks.title: Attendance Hotline
content_blocks.text: Call 515-242-7504 or send an absence note in Infinite Campus stating student name, grade, and reason.
Excused absences include illness, doctor/dental appointments with note, and family emergencies.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကပာ်ဖျါတၢ်တဟဲကၠိ
Cómo revisar la asistencia
article_translations.summary: Monitorea la puntualidad y faltas por periodo en tiempo real desde la aplicación Campus Parent.

content_blocks.text: Revisar la asistencia regularmente asegura que tu hijo esté en clase y previene problemas de ausentismo crónico.

article_translations.title: How to Monitor Student Attendance
article_translations.summary: Track period-by-period attendance and tardiness in real time using the Campus Parent app.

content_blocks.text: Regularly checking attendance ensures your student is in class and prevents chronic absenteeism.

article_translations.title: ကျဲလၢကကွၢ်ထီဒါတၢ်ဟဲကၠိ
article_translations.summary: ကွၢ်တၢ်ဟဲကၠိဖဲ Campus Parent app အပူၤ.

content_blocks.text: ကွၢ်တၢ်ဟဲကၠိခီဖျိ Campus Parent app ဒ်သိးကၠိဖိကအိၣ်ဖဲကၠိပူၤလၢာ်လၢာ်.

article_translations.title: Políticas importantes para las familias
article_translations.summary: Uso de teléfonos celulares en clase, código de vestimenta y normas de convivencia escolar.

items: Teléfonos celulares: Deben permanecer guardados y en silencio durante las horas de clase.
Identificación escolar: Los estudiantes deben portar su credencial visible durante el día.
Seguridad: Todas las puertas exteriores permanecen cerradas; los visitantes deben ingresar por la puerta principal con identificación.

article_translations.title: Important Policies for Families
article_translations.summary: Classroom cell phone policy, student dress code, and campus safety rules.

items: Cell Phones: Must be stored and silenced during classroom instruction time.
Student IDs: Students must wear their school badges visibly on campus.
Building Security: All exterior doors are locked; visitors must enter through main entrance with photo ID.

content_blocks.text: ကၠိဖိတဖၣ်တဘၣ်သူ လီတဲစိဖဲတၢ်မၤလိဆၢကတီၢ်ဘၣ် ဒီးကဘၣ်ဒိးကၠိဖိကဒ်ထီဘိ.

article_translations.title: Dónde pedir ayuda en Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Enlaces bilingües (BFL), despensa comunitaria, consejeros de salud mental y recursos de comida y vivienda.

content_blocks.title: Equipo Bilingüe para Familias (BFL)
content_blocks.text: Nuestros enlaces familiares hablan tu idioma y te ayudan con trámites, citas escolares y recursos comunitarios.
Recursos Disponibles en la Escuela

items: Despensa Escolar de Alimentos: Comida y ropa gratuita para estudiantes y familias.
Consejeros Académicos y de Salud Mental: Apoyo confidencial para el bienestar de tu hijo.
Asistencia de Vivienda y Servicios: Conexión con programas de Polk County y United Way 211.

article_translations.title: Where to Get Help & Support at Lincoln
article_translations.summary: Bilingual Family Liaisons (BFL), school food pantry, mental health counselors, and housing resources.

content_blocks.title: Bilingual Family Liaisons (BFL)
content_blocks.text: Our family liaisons speak your language and assist with school forms, conferences, and community aid.
Available Support at School

items: School Food Pantry: Free food, winter coats, and essentials for students and families.
Academic & Mental Health Counselors: Confidential guidance for student well-being.
Housing & Utility Aid: Direct connections to Polk County and United Way 211 resources.

article_translations.title: ဖဲလဲၣ်လၢကဒိးန့ၢ်တၢ်မၤစၢၤဖဲ Lincoln အပူၤ

content_blocks.text: BFL ပှၤမၤစၢၤတဖၣ် ကတိၤနကျိာ်သ့ ဒီးကမၤစၢၤနၤလၢ ကၠိတၢ်ပရၢဒီးတၢ်မၤစၢၤအဂၤတဖၣ်အပူၤ.
